evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & Africa, Vol. V No. 109, 7 June 1982
evidence.snippet: DAILY REPORT MIDDLE EAST AND SOUTH ASIA REVIEW 7 JUNE 1982 Israeli Invasion of Lebanon Military Situation -- Israeli forces moved into southern Lebanon along three axes: the coast, the central sector and the "Fatahland" area, the IDF spokesman announced on 6 June in a statement report…
